section.title: Inattentive Driving Warning function
section.p: Driver Attention Warning monitors your driving pattern. When your attention is below a certain level, Driver Attention Warning recommends a break to help with safe driving.

section.title: Leading Vehicle Departure Alert function
section.p: Leading Vehicle Departure Alert informs you when a detected vehicle ahead departs from a stop.

section.title: Detection sensor
section.p: Please refer to for the applicable sensors and their locations.
